svg.title: When the release pull request is rebuilt
svg.desc: A merge into main starts the release bot. A merge that changes the notes of the release pull request, such as a feat, a fix or a perf, has release-please rebuild it on main at once. A merge that changes nothing that it releases, such as docs, chore, ci or test, rebuilds it only when auto-merge is on for it; otherwise it stays behind main, which holds up nothing. Once you turn auto-merge on, the branch bot starts the release bot, unless a run of it that came since still runs. The daily run, which also turns auto-merge on for a release of dependency updates, and a run by hand rebuild it as well. Rebuilt on main, its checks run, and it merges once they pass. The branch bot never updates its branch.
